description: §55.5.1: a validated top-level value that nothing binds has the full surface (no E-VALIDITY-NO-SURFACE, no E-VALIDATOR-DEAD — it is `let`, §55.5.2); at construction `""` with `req` reads isValid false, touched false, submitted false.
rationale: §55.5.1 rule 1: "A top-level value that carries validators synthesizes the per-field surface — isValid, errors, touched — plus submitted … This holds always — bound or not". Rule 4: "the surface is computed at construction (an initial `""` with `req` reads `isValid == false` before any interaction". §55.5.2: E-VALIDATOR-DEAD needs "no write grant — the value is locked"; a `let` value is live.
